questions.q: Which is a relief printing process?
questions.why: Lino printing uses the raised surface of the block; the carved parts stay white.

questions.q: Why must lettering be carved in reverse on a lino block?
options: It prints as a mirror image
questions.why: The print is a mirror image of the block.

options: A print made in an edition of 50
A print on a single colour
A one-off print from an inked smooth plate
questions.why: Mono means one; each monoprint is unique.

questions.q: Explain the difference between collage and assemblage.
questions.model: Collage sticks flat materials such as paper or photographs onto a surface. Assemblage arranges three-dimensional or found objects together.
